proposals.evidence: Full akasa has sky from the Sanskrit head through Pali/Prakrit akasa. Odia akasau retains the full stem with its source ending; Kaithali kas and Kullui kas have initial-vowel loss. These are qualified regional matches; source spelling and possible learned or cross-IA transmission are preserved. Exact response: akasau.
